effect:
Enables radio functionality on your Pokégear. Listen to various radio stations including Pokémon March (raises wild encounter rate), Pokémon Lullaby (lowers wild encounter rate), and the Pokéflute channel (wakes sleeping Pokémon).

Complete the Radio Tower tour quiz on the first floor. Answer all questions correctly to receive the card.
